messages:
raj: getting weird behavior with PagerDuty delivery — a bunch of alerts from inference-prod either delayed by minutes or not arriving at all. mobile push acks missing. anyone else seeing this?
emmie: yep seeing gaps in the alert stream, our alert dashboard shows a spike but no corresonding PD incidents in the last 3m.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty status: Degraded Performance in Notification Delivery for region us-east-1 — https://status.pagerduty.com/ (ref: PD-DELIV-2026). They report increased delivery latency and failed mobile push retries.
raj: thanks — that explains it. impact looks like alert ack delays and some dupes when retries kick in.
opsbot: creating incident INC-2026-145 in our tracker and adding channel notes.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-145 created by opsbot for 'PagerDuty notification delays affecting inference-prod'. Priority: high.
sorin: i'm taking lead on the incident. oncall handover in 2m. tagging @emmie for metrics and @jen for routing changes.
emmie: grabbing metrics: 5xx rate on hosted inference rose from 0.2% baseline to 2.1% in last 10m for a subset of tenants. alert volume doubled due to retries.
jen: to avoid alert storm i'm going to temporarly silence some noisy symbology alerts and route critical-only to #inc-sev1 manually. will post commands.
jen: command: ```incctl silence --service inference-prod --duration 30m --reason "PD delivery lag"```
raj: good. also, PD mobile push seems flaky — our mobile push ack metric shows many pending acks. we should fallback to phone/SMS for pager duty oncalls until this resolved.
sorin: manual escalation plan: 1) enable SMS and phone routing for primary oncall 2) trigger manual phone calls for owners listed 3) post short status to status.redwood.com
opsbot: executing manual route change: ```routerctl update-route --id oncall-inference --fallback phone,sms --priority critical```
jen: added a webhook path to send critical alerts directly to #inc-sev1 as a backup: ```aws lambda -> slack webhook``` will take effect in ~1m.
raj: opened ticket with PagerDuty support, ref PD-TICKET-78910, included delivery logs and timestamps. pinged PD on Slack escalation channel.
pagerduty-bot: PD Support acknowledged ticket PD-TICKET-78910 and set priority to P2. They advise continuing with your mitigations while they investigate third-party push infra.
emmie: customer impact check: only 3 customers showed degraded request success and those correlate with the time window of alert delivery gaps — recommending status page update: "intermittent alerting and notifications for some customers; backend serving degraded for a small subset"
sorin: agreed, please publish a short status update. @raj can you post to status.redwood.com and paste the link here?
raj: posted: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-145 — short note and contact info.
jen: reminder: we should avoid mass re-alerting once PD recovers — put a suppression window on retriggering alerts for the next 30m. command: ```incctl set-retrigger-window --service inference-prod --window 30m```
opsbot: suppression set.
raj: on-call handoff note: i'll be offline in 10m and sorin will remain lead. sorin — anything you need from me before I drop?
sorin: i'm good, please forward any PD replies. i'll coordinate with PD support and track mitigation timeline.
emmie: action items: 1) sorin to coordinate with PD support and update this thread 2) jen to keep webhooks and silences in place 3) raj to monitor customer contacts and update status page 4) postmortem owner: emmie.
jen: creating a followup runbook for fallback routing and adding it to runbooks/inference-pd-fallback.md in docs.
opsbot: note logged: manual phone paging used for primary oncall, SMS fallback enabled, webhook to slack active, suppression window 30m.
pagerduty-bot: PD status now shows "investigating" -> "identifying root cause". Will update.
raj: thanks all — keep posting short updates here. if PD confirms full resolution, we'll coordinate a short postmortem and next steps with PD on detection/backup routes.
sorin: update: PD reports a problem with their mobile push provider causing delayed pushes; ETA unknown. continuing manual paging.
emmie: marking incident as active. setting 1h check-ins.
opsbot: last message: incident state = active, handoff_to = sorin, next_checkin = 1801234867.
(END OF THREAD)
